flags.why: The common adjective meaning “talented,” as in “Cô ấy rất tài năng,” is missing ([dictionary](https://tudientiengviet.org/tai-nang/)).
flags.fix:
adj | talented; gifted
ex: Cô ấy rất tài năng. = She is very talented.

flags.why: The everyday adjective meaning “wasteful” is missing ([dictionary](https://vdict.com/l%C3%A3ng%20ph%C3%AD%2C2%2C0%2C0.html)).
flags.fix:
adj | wasteful
ex: Mua rồi không dùng thì lãng phí quá. = Buying it and then not using it is so wasteful.

flags.why: “Tin đó đã sốc cả nhà tôi” unnaturally uses “sốc” directly with the people affected as its object.
flags.fix: Tin đó làm cả nhà tôi sốc. = That news shocked my whole family.
